original_question: Jerry has two pools, both with leaks emptying them out at 4 gallons/minute. 4 minutes ago, the big pool had twice as much water as the small pool. Now the big pool has four times as much water as the small pool. How much water does the small pool have now?
question_template: {name_male, Jerry} has two pools, both with leaks emptying them out at {num_digit_1, 4} gallons/minute. {num_digit_2, 4} minutes ago, the big pool had {num_text_1, twice} as much water as the small pool. Now the big pool has {num_text_2, four} times as much water as the small pool. How much water does the small pool have now?
question_solution: answer = (f1 - 1) * num_digit_1 * num_digit_2 / (f2 - f1)  # f1 and f2 are the numeric values of num_text_1 and num_text_2
